front_line: A toll booth on consumer credit that quietly compounds through pricing power, mission-critical software, and near-impossible replacement risk.
thesis: Fair Isaac (FICO) combines an irreplaceable credit-scoring standard with high-margin decision-management software, creating exceptional recurring cash flow and pricing power. Despite a premium valuation, the business has consistently compounded intrinsic value through durable competitive advantages, capital-light economics, and disciplined capital allocation.
moat: Owns the embedded standard of US credit via coordination-cost switching, strong but contested at the mortgage edge.
risks: FHFA/VantageScore competition attacks the most inelastic, highest-margin slice — and it appears in zero grounded sources here, so the magnitude is genuinely unverified.

drafts.x_post: Fair Isaac (FICO) ($FICO): FICO owns the credit score most US lenders use to decide who gets a loan and at what rate. Dead Simple Score: 97/100 · Platinum. Status: Open.
video_talking_points: FICO owns the credit score most US lenders use to decide who gets a loan and at what rate.

Open. The asymmetry is real and the moat is genuinely strong, so a de-rated standard-owner at its own bear case deserves capital as a monitored satellite — but this is an asymmetric bet on one unconfirmed fact, not the near-certain compounder the 97 implied. Confidence moved from Zack's "irreplaceable / near-impossible replacement" starting hypothesis to "strong but contested at one specific edge": the research confirmed the moat and the attractive price, but weakened the certainty — the stock's own price is voting against "irreplaceable." What would change the verdict: the Nov 3 print — double-digit mortgage-score growth with reaffirmed price hikes pushes toward "confirmed compounder"; single-digit growth or silence on mortgage pricing pushes toward Close.

A sophisticated AI-powered decision engine sits at the center, quietly directing banks, mortgages, credit cards, and lending decisions. Modern financial institutions surround the bridge with glowing skyscrapers and secure data centers.
